question: What becomes of the self when the body perishes, according to the analogy?
premises: Space does not perish when the pot is broken.
The self is compared to that space.
The knower is established as independent and Śiva-natured.
inference: The self does not perish with the body but abides as Śiva and pervades all things.
plain_english: Just as space does not perish when the pot is broken, so this self does not perish; the knower becomes Śiva-natured, independent, and extends into all things.
